text_block_list.text: As the days approached the Shinzan Kinen—

"...Silently, I reviewed footage of Tanino 
Gimlet's training, paced runs, and mock 
races, searching for areas to improve."

"We chose the Shinzan Kinen as the stage 
to show the fruits of our daily training 
in the Junior year. We cannot afford a 
half-hearted performance there."
choice_data_list:
(I have to do whatever I can for 
Gimlet...)

text_block_list.text:
"『Love the moment.』 In order to live up 
to her words, I sacrificed sleep and 
devoted myself to research—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —My bad habit, you say?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Though it's only at the level of a 
possibility.

Yeah. Though it's only a possibility at 
this point.

text_block_list.text:
Watching the footage of Tanino Gimlet over 
and over, a certain thought crossed my 
mind.

That when running on the inside while 
boxed in by the pack, pushing outward on 
the final stretch causes her run to drift 
outside.

Until now, Tanino Gimlet's tremendous 
explosive power had likely compensated for 
the situations caused by that bad habit of 
hers.

"However, the race ahead will be uncharted 
territory for Tanino Gimlet. Even the 
explosive speed that worked until now—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...It won't work against the strong. So 
you're saying there's that possibility.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Hahaha...! 
Haaah-hah-hah-haaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――Is this what joy feels like?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"You don't seem to realize it. A madness 
unlike anything seen before is beginning 
to take dwell within both of your eyes—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh— Magnificent, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That ability to unearth the subtle 
dissonance within myself, which even I 
could barely perceive—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Truly, how dependable.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Naturally, you have prepared one, haven't 
you? A way to correct my wicked disorder.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then let us devote our remaining time to 
that. I must face this as a more perfected 
version of myself, after all!

And so, Tanino Gimlet and I made our final 
preparations for the Shinzan Kinen—

—And then, the day of the Shinzan Kinen 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Tanino Gimlet is looking super calm 
and composed. This race is gonna set the 
tone for the whole year—expectations are 
high!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Now, look up and revere me...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This is the sweet beginning—of my 
chronicles of destruction, wrought by my 
own hand—
